perks.name: No Distractions
perks.description: Aiming this weapon for a short period reduces flinch.

perks.name: Rangefinder
perks.description: Aiming this weapon increases its effective range and zoom magnification. Increased projectile velocity while aiming Rocket Launchers, Grenade Launchers, and Bows.

perks.name: Ambitious Assassin
perks.description: Overflows the magazine based on the number of rapid kills before reloading.

perks.name: Auto-Loading Holster
perks.description: The holstered weapon is automatically reloaded after a short period of time.

perks.name: Field Prep
perks.description: Increases ammo generation. Faster reload, stow, and ready speed when you're crouching.

perks.name: Outlaw
perks.description: Precision kills greatly decrease reload time.

perks.name: Pulse Monitor
perks.description: Automatically reloads the magazine and improves weapon handling when wounded—even when this weapon is stowed.

perks.name: Tunnel Vision
perks.description: Reloading after defeating a target greatly increases target acquisition and aim down sight speed for a short duration.

perks.name: Under Pressure
perks.description: Improved stability and accuracy as the magazine gets lower.

perks.name: Surplus
perks.description: Increases handling, reload speed, and stability for each fully charged ability.

perks.name: Lead from Gold
perks.description: Picking up Heavy ammo also grants ammo to this weapon.

perks.name: Feeding Frenzy
perks.description: Each rapid kill with this weapon progressively increases reload speed for a short time.

perks.name: Firing Line
perks.description: This weapon deals increased precision damage when near two or more allies.

perks.name: Snapshot Sights
perks.description: Faster time to aim down sights.

perks.name: Rampage
perks.description: Kills with this weapon temporarily grant increased damage. Stacks 3x.

perks.name: Opening Shot
perks.description: Improved accuracy and range on the opening shot of attack.

perks.name: Fourth Time's the Charm
perks.description: Rapidly landing precision hits will return two rounds to the magazine.

perks.name: High-Impact Reserves
perks.description: Rounds at the end of the magazine deal more damage.

perks.name: Box Breathing
perks.description: Aiming this weapon for a short period without firing grants bonus range and precision damage that resets after firing or exiting zoom.

perks.name: Osmosis
perks.description: Using your grenade ability partially refills the magazine and changes this weapon's damage type to match your grenade until you stow it.

perks.name: Elemental Capacitor
perks.description:
Increased stats based on the currently equipped Super.
• [Solar] increases your reload speed.
• [Arc] increases handling.
• [Void] increases stability.
• [Stasis] moderately controls recoil and increases movement speed when aiming down sights.
• [Strand] increases airborne effectiveness.

perks.name: Frenzy
perks.description: Being in combat for an extended time increases damage, handling, and reload for this weapon until you are out of combat.

perks.name: Thresh
perks.description: Killing combatants with this weapon generates a small amount of Super energy.

perks.name: Demolitionist
perks.description: Kills with this weapon generate grenade energy. Activating your grenade ability reloads this weapon from reserves.

perks.name: Eye of the Storm
perks.description: This weapon becomes more accurate and boosts handling as your health gets lower.

flavor: "They think violence will bring peace. Maybe it can." —Eris Morn
